03 / THE APPROACH
HOW DR. SURABHI WORKS

A closer look before a treatment plan.

People often come to the clinic after trying medicines, physiotherapy, injections or other treatments. Dr. Surabhi's process begins by understanding the person, then selecting suitable techniques rather than offering the same routine to everyone.

01

Understand your history and daily difficulties

The first consultation covers your health history, current complaints, earlier treatments and the activities you want to return to.

02

Assess before recommending

Dr. Surabhi describes using Naadi Pariksha and postural analysis, with attention to movement, alignment and other relevant factors, before advising on a course of action.

03

Combine techniques where appropriate

The approach may bring together Marma Chikitsa and selected Ayurvedic pain-management therapies. Depending on the person, this can include Pottali Sekam, medicated steam, Lepam, medicines or Panchakarma.

04

Support the plan beyond the clinic visit

Diet advice, movement or exercise, home practices and follow-up may form part of a plan shaped around the patient's goals and response.

The treatments used and the results possible depend on the individual assessment. An online questionnaire cannot determine clinical suitability.

04 / MEET YOUR DOCTOR
DR. SURABHI VAIDYA

Care shaped around the person behind the pain.

Dr. Surabhi Vaidya holds a BAMS and an MBA in Clinical Research. At Charak Health Solutions in Thane, her stated focus is the combination of Marma Chikitsa with personalised Ayurvedic pain-management techniques.

For patients, the goal is practical: to discuss what may help with walking, stairs, getting up from a chair, travel and independence. The recommendation begins with an in-person assessment and varies with the condition.
